user_request: 继续用astra ultra。执行117的goal再做3个结果
interpretation: Three independently accepted implementation/baseline results for the already admitted single workflow, not three new sources or three claimed innovations.

results.deliverable: Executable finite posted-buffer/descriptor/frame/ownership/publication/consumer/release adapter and meaningful correctness tests
Actual host CPU direct-copy baseline on the same frozen inputs, all real resources/costs with instrumentation separated
Actual single-DMA ordinary baseline executing real iDMA/IOMMU RTL and checking full bytes, successful transfer IDs, completion, quiet, lifecycle and traffic conservation

measurement_boundaries: Generated functional frames are not a native traffic trace.
Host CPU nanoseconds and RTL model cycles are different timing domains; no direct speedup ratio.
Source-required delivery costs and checker/trace costs must be separate, while full actual cost remains reported.
Useful bytes, read bus bytes/beats and write strobes/bytes/beats must be distinguished.
RTL behavioral DDR and absent real CPU/cache/board timing must be reported.
Serial device presence alone is not proof of board identity, loaded image or tested driver.
acceptance: Root reviews actual code and raw execution evidence for all three results, then synchronizes current status/handoff/validation before completing the actual goal.
